use.rock: weathered grey-brown cliff rock, the colours of the ORIGINAL Beodeul cliff and earth (0-1 violet-black cracks and deep clefts, 2-3 shaded facets and undersides, 4-6 body, 7-8 lit facets, 9 rare edge glints)
use.stone: grey mountain rock and dressed stone, the Beodeul boulder ramp (0-1 crevices and outlines, 2-3 shaded planes, 4-5 body, 6-8 lit planes and edges)
use.earth: packed bare earth of a trodden path (0-1 cracks and deep shade, 2 seams, 3-4 body, 5 lit, 6-7 lit edges)
use.grass: grass, leaves, moss, herbs, the Beodeul meadow ramp (0-1 deep shade, 2-4 body, 5-8 lit blades and tips)
use.dark: neutral violet-black: contact shadows on the ground, deep hollows (0 darkest, 5 faintest)
use.timber: logs, planks, posts, the Beodeul log-cabin ramp (0-1 gaps and outlines, 2-4 shaded wood, 5-6 body, 7-9 lit wood and cut ends)
use.hide: leather, hides, canvas and rope (0-1 shade, 2-3 body, 4-5 lit)
use.glow: spirit glow: luminous teal of glowing caps, runes, wisps, enchanted water (0-1 dark teal rim, 2-3 body, 4-5 bright, 6-7 white-hot core)
use.petal: violet-pink petals, fairy flowers, faint violet magic (0-1 shade, 2-3 body, 4 pale tip)
use.gold: gold and brass: lock plates, bowls, inlay (0-1 shade, 2 body, 3-4 shine)
use.snow: snow, the Beodeul snowfield ramp (0-1 blue shade, 2-4 body, 5-6 lit snow)
use.moon: moonlit blue: moon water, night stone tint, cold light (0-1 deep, 2-3 body, 4-5 light, 6 glint)
use.water: dark calm water, the Beodeul river ramp (0-2 depth, 3-4 body, 5-6 ripple dashes, 7 a rare glint)
use.birch: pale silver-white bark and pale stone (0-1 violet shade and bark marks, 2-3 body, 4-5 lit)
use.leaf: the foliage of the ORIGINAL Beodeul forest, sampled from it: 29 tones from the near-black teal gaps between crowns (0-3) through deep shaded leaf masses (4-12), body greens (13-21) to lit yellow-green leaf tips (22-28). Use MANY of these tones (25 or more): neighbouring tones are deliberately close
use.aura: the spirit twist: leaves touched by spirit light, a slightly cooler luminous green (0-1 shade, 2-4 body, 5-6 glowing tips) - a minority accent on top of the leaf ramp, never the main foliage colour
use.sky: clear daytime sky (0 zenith blue ... 6 pale horizon)
use.haze: far mountains seen through air: blue-grey silhouettes (0 nearest and darkest ... 5 farthest and palest)
